title: Home Game Balance Settlement Aging
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokerhome:session
| search settlement_status="complete"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by player_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which playerss have gone quiet for settled poker balances.
value: Settlement aging keeps a fun home game from quietly accumulating awkward unpaid balances.
implementation: Send settled poker balances events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of playerss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which playerss have gone quiet longer than they should for settled poker balances.
